page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c16g1.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance built on the KVM hypervisor. Hardware specifications include an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz with 16 vCPUs across 8 physical cores on the x86_64 architecture. Memory capacity is configured at 62 GB, providing 3.88 GB of RAM per vCPU. Acceleration is supplied by a single NVIDIA T4 GPU featuring 16 GB of Turing-generation VRAM. The instance includes no local storage, requiring network-attached storage for system disks, and delivers 6 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth.

Benchmark results highlight strong specialized processing capabilities alongside moderate host CPU throughput. In LLM prompt processing tests, the instance achieves top-tier results, reaching 8,410.67 tokens per second on a 135M parameter model and 1,141.42 tokens per second on a 7B parameter model. Medium model text generation reaches 34.57 tokens per second. Host compute performance falls into the middle tier, marked by a multi-core Geekbench score of 5,951.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 13,056.17. Single-core CPU benchmarks remain weak, as reflected by a Geekbench single-core score of 937.0 and lower-quartile stress-ng single-core throughput.

From an infrastructure cost perspective, the instance provides an entry point into dedicated GPU computing without the high resource overhead of multi-accelerator platforms. Workload tradeoffs include lower single-threaded CPU speed and dependence on remote block storage due to the absence of onboard NVMe drives. The server fits small to mid-sized machine learning inference, real-time video transcoding, image processing pipelines, and distributed inference workers.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c16g1.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server designed for machine learning inference and parallelized processing. Built on the x86_64 architecture using the KVM hypervisor, it contains an Intel Xeon 8163 processor with 16 vCPUs and 8 physical cores at 2.5 GHz, paired with 62 GB of system memory. Acceleration is provided by one NVIDIA T4 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM. The instance carries no local storage, relying on external network volumes, and features 6 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark data indicates strong GPU throughput, evidenced by top-tier prompt processing on 7B language models, although single-core CPU execution scores in the lower quartile. This configuration fits deep learning model serving, video transcoding, and graphics rendering workloads.
